title.en: los jueves on calle feria, the antiques market.
title.de: los jueves in der calle feria, der antikmarkt.
title.tr: calle feria'da los jueves, antika pazarı.

line.en: the thursday antiques and flea market on calle feria, open 08:30 to 14:00. mild weather, with some rain risk later in the week, so go early.
line.de: der donnerstagsmarkt für antiquitäten und flohmarkt in der calle feria, 08:30 bis 14:00. mild, mit etwas regenrisiko später in der woche; also früh hingehen.
line.tr: calle feria'daki perşembe antika ve bit pazarı, 08:30 ile 14:00 arası açık. hava ılık, hafta sonuna doğru yağmur ihtimali var; erken git.

sparks.why: Los Jueves antiques and flea market on calle Feria, Thursdays 08:30 to 14:00 (Seville market listing site); rain risk from local press forecasts (elpespunte, sevillaactualidad).
